# Data Pipeline: absent-from-chronic

Execution guide for the CCHS work-absenteeism data pipeline.

## Overview

```
CCHS .sav files (private raw storage)
         │
         ▼  1-ferry.R   ← zero semantic transformation
  cchs-1.sqlite + raw parquet backup   (staging)
         │
         ▼  2-ellis.R   ← white-list + harmonize + recode
  cchs-2.sqlite + analysis-ready parquet tables
         │
         ▼  2-test-ellis-cache.R   ← alignment verification
  console report (pass/fail)
```

## Scripts

| # | File | Pattern | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `manipulation/1-ferry.R` | Ferry | Staging SQLite + raw Parquet backup |
| 2 | `manipulation/2-ellis.R` | Ellis | Analysis-ready SQLite + Parquet tables |
| 3 | `manipulation/2-test-ellis-cache.R` | Test | Console test report (three-way alignment check) |
| — | `manipulation/example/ferry-lane-example.R` | Example | Demo staging output |
| — | `manipulation/example/ellis-lane-example.R` | Example | Demo analysis-ready output |

> A third Ellis lane produced additional derived outputs; documentation is in the CACHE Manifest.

## Ferry lane summary

`1-ferry.R` is a transport script. It ingests source SPSS files and writes staging artifacts with no analytical recoding.

Permitted operations include:

- SPSS ingestion
- Label stripping for storage compatibility
- Mechanical column name normalization
- SQLite/Parquet writing

## Ellis lane summary

`2-ellis.R` applies white-listing, harmonization, recoding, and sample-construction logic to produce analysis-ready tables.

Key diagnostics and interpretation guidance are documented in:

- [CACHE Manifest](cache-manifest.qmd)
- [INPUT Manifest](input-manifest.qmd)
